jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain Team we are looking for a Configuration & Logistics Officer who ensures that for a given engine, the pieces are made available for assembly within the configuration and timeframe agreed with the customer.

Your role:

• You will analyse and provide the logistical needs to complete the engine.
• You read and understand the logistical aspects of the Bill of Work for the engine.
• You detect critical points in the completion process and look for an appropriate solution to achieve the objectives (e.g. Standard Exchanges, switches between different engines).
• You direct your internal suppliers (warehouse, backshop, subcontracting, purchasing).
• You complete the modules and ensure that they are prepared according to the predetermined production planning.
• You support the assembly line with missing and/or defective parts.
• You analyse the interchangeability (technical and qualitative) of pieces, in accordance with the established configuration.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain or a technical direction, or equivalent through experience.
• You have an interest in aircraft engines and want to learn more about them.
• You are communicative and dare to ask questions.
• You work in a structured, accurate and proactive way.
• You work analytically and come up with practical solutions.
• You organize, divide and control your work independently.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• You work in shifts, from Monday to Friday (6 am - 2 pm, 2 pm - 10 pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels, a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, is located at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium). We specialize in the inspection, maintenance, and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. Over the past years, we have successfully expanded our team of Jet Engine Mechanics. As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a limited number of additional mechanics who combine strong technical skills, precision and a genuine passion for aircraft engines. We are looking for people who aspire to become true LEAP engine specialists and who want to contribute to one of the world's leading LEAP engine MRO facilities.The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your RoleAs a Jet Engine Mechanic, you will ensure the airworthiness and performance of LEAP engines through maintenance, disassembly & assembly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

Your ProfileWe are looking for mechanics who take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in aircraft engines
• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset
• Curiosity, motivation and a willingness to continuously learn
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

The job location is Leuven.
 

The ATE Test Development Engineer is responsible for the ATE test implementation and optimization making use of our ATE test setup. From the initial ASIC development kick-off until end of life, the ATE Test Development Engineer will be responsible for defining ATE test software and supporting the launch of new products into high volume production. Together with the test engineers in our bench test lab, the ATE Test Development Engineer keeps a clear overview, ensuring a strong overall test methodology. This position is part of the product engineering group of ICsense and cooperates with cross-functional teams of Test engineers, Design (DFT), Product Engineering, Reliability, Foundry.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Responsible for the implementation and performance of production tests of ICsense ASICs, taking into account quality and test performance 
 

• Set up, implementation, debug and optimization of test programs for automated testing 

• Work with ICsense test engineers to correlate bench test results and ATE test results for debug, characterization, … 

• Ensure the test program is scalable (multi-site), re-usable and accurate (GR&R)   

• Drive continuous improvements to product quality and customer satisfaction throughout the lifecycle of the product 
 

• Investigate ATE test setup related problems, find the root cause and propose ATE test setup/software adaptations to the project team to overcome these problems 

• Work on yield improvement/test time reduction programs together with the product quality team   

Competencies
 
 

• You have a Master degree in Industrial engineering 

• You have at least 3 years of experience in ATE test development 

• Background with ATE test development software is required 

• Experience with one of the main ATE programming languages is required: VBA, C++ or Java 

• Team player with a strong sense of urgency to meet test requirements on schedule 

• You communicate fluently in English (oral and written)

Some people wait for opportunities.

Others create them.

We're looking for a Business Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building powerful client relationships, and turning business challenges into consulting solutions.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Omschrijving

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge
 

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• Youprobably have: 
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Mostimportantly: 
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

The school is seeking an passionate Physical Education (PE) Teacher for a late August 2025 start date preferably with a strong background in UK Secondary Education and the Cambridge Curriculum. The successful candidate will be expected to undertake a pastoral role in the school and to contribute to the school's co-curriculum. This role also encompasses curriculum development for our expanding secondary school as we grow organically year by year up to Year 13.  

Key Responsibilities:

	
• Plan and deliver engaging and high-quality P.E. lessons across all key stages (Key Stage 1 - 4).
	
• Teach and support students studying IGCSE P.E., ensuring strong subject knowledge and exam preparation.
	
• Foster a positive and inclusive sporting environment that encourages participation and teamwork.
	
• Develop students' physical skills, fitness, and understanding of healthy lifestyles.
	
• Organise and contribute to extracurricular sports clubs, fixtures, and school sporting events.
	
• Work collaboratively with colleagues to promote a strong sports culture within the school.

 
BJAB is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. All candidates will be subject to background checks in line with British Overseas Standards.  

Successful candidates must have the following qualifications:  

• Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) 
• Experience teaching IGCSE Physical Education or in a British secondary school or similar educational setting
• Degree in Physical Education or related subject (e.g., sports science, coaching)
• Ability to carry out practical swimming instruction is required
• Experience teaching PE in a British school setting, either in the UK or abroad (desirable)
• An excellent knowledge of UK education and the National Curriculum of England , particularly of the IGCSE P.E. curriculum and assessment
• A passion for promoting health, fitness, and sportsmanship
• Strong subject knowledge and pedagogical skills
• Excellent communication, organisational, and interpersonal skills
• Ability to inspire and motivate students of varying ages and abilities
• Strong communication and organisational skills
• Native or Fluent mastery level of English  
• The right to work in Belgium and/or eligibility for sponsorship under a Belgian work visa programme 
 

Applications without these essential criteria will not be considered. We welcome applications from ECTs for this role. 

The following experience is highly desirable:  

• Teaching experience in Key Stage 3 and/or 4 or (I)GCSE in a British school or a British international school   
• Ability to teach an additional related subjects would be a clear asset 
• Experience of delivering the Duke of Edinburgh program or willingness to be trained to do so would be an additional benefit
This position will begin in August 2027 for an indefinite time. We only welcome candidates interested in full-time employment for this role. If interested, kindly submit the TES application form. The Headteacher, Mr Francis Retter (f.retter@bjab.org) also welcomes a short covering letter and CV. Applications will be considered on a rolling basis and short-listed candidates may be contacted before the advertising end date. 
 
An ability to work as a team-player and be flexible are pre-requisites for the part. We look for teachers with the ability to support, nurture and challenge children from a range of backgrounds and starting points. Creativity and flexibility, professional rigour and integrity, expectations of high standards, high levels of pastoral care and support are the hallmarks of our professional team.  

Working at BJAB offers:  

	
• A competitive salary based on years of teaching experience and qualifications  
	
• Lunch vouchers for each working day  
	
• Ecological product vouchers  
	
• Transport compensation  
	
• Pension plan  
	
• Hospitalisation insurance (family included)  
	
• Opportunities for professional development and advancement with responsibilities within the school

About the Role

The HR Manager will be responsible for the administrative and operational HR functions at CLERENS, and supporting the company's recruitment and training activities.

The role is primarily hands-on and operational, with a strong focus on HR administration (including payroll-related coordination), while also contributing to recruitment processes and internal capacity building.

The HR Manager will work under the responsibility of the Business Director and in close coordination with the Board of the company.

Key Responsibilities

HR administration and payroll coordination

?     Manage day-to-day HR administration for CLERENS staff.

?     Coordinate payroll processes with external providers, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with Belgian labour and social security regulations.

Manage employment contracts, amendments, onboarding and offboarding processes.

Maintain and update personnel records, HR databases, and internal documentation.

Act as a first point of contact for staff on HR-related administrative questions.

Recruitment support

Support the full recruitment cycle, including:

o     drafting and publishing job offers;

o     coordinating applications and interviews;

o     liaising with candidates and internal interviewers.

 Support onboarding processes for new hires, in coordination with team leads and management.

Training and staff development

Support the identification, planning, and organisation of internal and external training activities.

Coordinate logistics related to trainings, workshops, and professional development initiatives.

Maintain an overview of training participation and support follow-up where needed.

HR processes and internal support

contribute to the improvement and structuring of internal HR processes and procedures.

Support the Business Director on HR-related reporting and internal follow-up.

Ensure confidentiality and professionalism in all HR-related matters.
 
Profile and Skills

Previous experience in an HR, administrative, or office management role, ideally in a consultancy or professional services environment.

Good knowledge of HR administration and payroll coordination; familiarity with Belgian labour law is needed.

Experience supporting recruitment processes and staff onboarding.

 Interest in or experience with training coordination and staff development is an asset.

Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

 Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Proactive, reliable, and service-oriented mindset.Comfortable working in a small, dynamic, and international team.

Fluency in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
 
What We Offer

A central role in the internal operations of a growing Brussels-based consultancy.

Close collaboration with management and direct exposure to organisational decision-making.

A dynamic, international, and professional working environment.

Opportunities to shape and improve HR processes as the organisation evolves.

jobs.occupation: Line Leader Slicing - Meat Company | Oudenaarde | 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.
The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety.    

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

jobs.description:
As Administrative Assistant, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Estates team. The position would suit someone who genuinely enjoys administrative coordination, document follow-up and contract management, and who is comfortable working in a dynamic environment. You are fluent in French, Dutch and English. The position is possible in 4/5th of Full Time.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

 

Description

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination, file management support role.

• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

Key Responsibilities

Project Procurement & Strategic Sourcing

• Develop and implement procurement strategies in collaboration with Project, Engineering and Commercial teams.
• Identify business requirements, potential suppliers and sourcing opportunities.
• Develop sourcing strategies and lead RFx / tendering processes.
• Prepare supplier consultations, analyze bids and develop sourcing recommendations.
• Lead negotiations on pricing, lead times, commercial and contractual terms and conditions.
• Identify cost reduction and value improvement opportunities throughout the procurement lifecycle.
• Develop Best-Cost Country Sourcing strategies, with a particular focus on Central and Eastern Europe.
Supplier Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with key strategic suppliers.
• Assess suppliers' capabilities, manufacturing capacity, geographical footprint and financial stability.

• Work closely with Supplier Quality / Supplier Performance teams.
Contract & Change Management

• Lead the preparation and negotiation of supplier contracts.

• Manage contractual changes, scope changes and claims.
• Assess the financial and contractual impact of changes and lead the associated negotiations.
• Ensure compliance with procurement procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Work with Finance / Accounts Payable teams to resolve discrepancies between invoices and purchase orders.
Project Management

• Manage several procurement projects simultaneously in an international environment.
• Define action plans and monitor milestones, risks and expected benefits.
• Identify potential roadblocks and coordinate their resolution.
• Provide regular reporting to key stakeholders.
• Coordinate project changes and ensure alignment between the various functions and teams involved.

You have significant experience in industrial procurement / project procurement, ideally gained within a technical and international environment.

• Significant experience managing complex projects.
• Strong knowledge of RFx, sourcing and supplier negotiations.

For a leading manufacturer in the machine building industry in the region, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this key engineering role, you will act as the technical owner for the complete electrical hardware design, ensuring every machine meets the highest quality and safety standards!

As Senior Electrical Engineer, you will take full ownership of the electrical engineering lifecycle:

• Concept & Project Planning: Participate in multidisciplinary project design meetings with mechanical and software engineers from the concept phase onwards, creating realistic project schedules and milestones.
• Electrical Design (EPLAN P8 & ProPanel): Translate draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed hardware guidelines. Design and adapt electrical schematics in EPLAN P8 and create 3D panel/enclosure layouts in EPLAN ProPanel.
